title: Halifax Bomber LL459
memorial_details: Wall mounted, portrait oriented wooden board with stop-rebated edges. Crown and RAAF wings carved into top of board with inscription and names carved below. Above the board are three flags namely; Royal Australian Air Force, Union flag and the Australian national flag.
inscription: RAAF / IN MEMORY OF / (6 NAMES) / Who gave their lives in / the service of freedom / when their / Halifax aircraft crashed / opposite this church on / Thursday 8th June, 1944
